Mission Local reported that MEDA had a recent history of buying small buildings and converting them to below-market-rate housing. The article said a proposed $105 million in low-interest loans under Proposition C would help nonprofit housing organizations buy at-risk properties and expand acquisitions; buildings bought by MEDA earlier that year averaged $400,000 per unit. This story describes a housing program, not the plans for a specific building, so it doesn’t establish whether anyone at a particular address would have to move.
